limitations: Selected-checkpoint B-then-A diagnostic does not establish stable causal score effect, natural-trigger effect, full-pool effect or formal gains.
Per-request elapsed nests inside branch elapsed and per-game450s; use unique program_recomputed elapsed for extra processing time, not cumulative summaries.
History action clocks are rebased by continuation epoch minus GameRun.started_at; actual cleanup/in-flight tails are retained.
Missing response entries are not by themselves proven timeouts; shared requests.jsonl responses are counted only after unique matching on all seven request fields.
All source/manifest checks are frozen provenance; live subset comes from arm metadata.

local_download_record_integrity.limits: Local hashes are downloader-generated, not platform-provided hashes. Official inventory completeness is independently supported by the final paginated API inventory:42 outputs, next-page token empty, plus exact platform log gives43 local files.
